writing.overall_comment: A strong, well-scoped architect subagent with crisp boundaries and output contracts, held back mainly by redundant skill restatements and a slightly verbose body.

dimensions.name: Delegation fit
dimensions.comment: The description names concrete triggers (architecture design, technology selection, ADRs) so a main agent can route confidently, though it could hint at when NOT to route.

dimensions.name: Prompt quality
dimensions.comment: Role, structured design process, response patterns, and an explicit output contract (ADRs, design docs with named sections) make expectations unambiguous.

dimensions.name: Boundaries
dimensions.comment: Clear must-nots (no implementation code, no unilateral system changes) with explicit hand-back conditions to development subagents and the main agent.

dimensions.name: Conciseness
dimensions.comment: Well-organized but padded—the four skills are listed twice (frontmatter and an 'Integrated Skills' section) and several competency lists repeat the same content, wasting tokens.

suggestions: Remove the duplicate listing of the four skills from either the frontmatter or the 'Integrated Skills' section, keeping one authoritative version.
Consolidate the repeated competency lists into a single section instead of restating the same content across multiple sections.
After deduplication, replace any remaining repeated competency phrasing with concise cross-references to the canonical list to reduce token usage.
